description: This file defines the ModuleService class, which manages modules within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and update module data via a data access object (ModuleDao).

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Service class for handling module-related operations such as retrieving module list and updating module status.

methods.name: getModuleDao
methods.description: Returns the ModuleDao instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of modules based on provided array.
